d:
Made by DrBlackJack and Kurocaze. Production was ended after only 2 (in-comic) years due to the wishes of the commissioner. Might be continued someday, but I wouldn't hold my breath. For now, enjoy some delectable Kurocaze fatties while I see if I can get another one of his works translated.

Pages 1 through 24 were reuploaded to increase resolution and to universalize image format to PNG.

Source: https://www.deviantart.com/dr-black-jack/gallery?q=K-ON+-+Seasons
